title: Twilio Conversation Relay - setup message
description: Source: core/omnichannel/.../twilio/VoiceRelayWebSocketHandler.java#handleSetup, read directly (2026-07-19). Only the three fields the handler actually calls node.path(...) on are required here; Twilio's real 'setup' message carries more fields (e.g. direction, customParameters) that this handler never reads and this schema does not constrain.

accountSid.description: Resolved via TenantResolutionService.resolveTenantSchema(TWILIO, accountSid); falls back to the DEFAULT_SCHEMA if unresolved, so an empty/unknown value does not itself fail setup - it degrades to the default tenant.

callSid.description: Stored in session attributes and used only for logging/correlation - never parsed for structure.

from.description: The caller's phone number - used as ChannelSessionService.resolveOrCreate's externalId (VOICE channel), same pairing-gate semantics as every other channel.
